If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply no correction for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment spikes to 1.0 in the last 2 days and forecast is overcorrected, reduce by 3–5% for early horizon.  
If sentiment drops to 0.0 in the last 3 days and forecast is undercorrected, increase by 2–4% for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is consistently 0.0 over 5 days and forecast is above true path, reduce by 5–7% for late horizon.
